parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing rigidity and shape to the furniture.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the door and base, enclosing the storage space and maintaining the cabinet’s overall stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing elevation and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures balance on the floor surface.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is the front panel made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges, and includes a handle for operation.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close the cabinet.
